questions.q: Why is UDP preferred over TCP for real-time voice calls?
options: It guarantees delivery of every packet
It avoids connection set-up and retransmission delays that harm real-time flow
questions.exp: Real-time voice tolerates some loss but not delay, so UDP's low overhead and no retransmission suit it.

questions.q: Which statement about linked allocation of disk blocks is correct?
options: It requires the file size to be known at creation
It needs no space for pointers
It does not support efficient direct access to the middle of a file
questions.exp: To reach block k, the k preceding blocks must be traversed through their pointers.

questions.q: Which DNS record type maps a host name to an IPv4 address?
questions.exp: The A record holds the IPv4 address of a host; AAAA holds IPv6.

questions.q: The range of integers that can be represented in 6-bit 2's complement form is
questions.exp: For n bits the range is -2^(n-1) to 2^(n-1) - 1, i.e. -32 to +31 for n = 6.

questions.q: An empty deque undergoes: insertFront(1), insertRear(2), insertFront(3), insertRear(4), deleteFront, deleteRear. What are the front and rear elements now?
questions.exp: The deque goes 1 -> 1 2 -> 3 1 2 -> 3 1 2 4; deleting both ends leaves 1 2.

questions.q: Which HTML5 input attribute displays a short hint inside a field that disappears when the user starts typing?
questions.exp: placeholder shows greyed hint text inside an empty input.

questions.q: The medium-term scheduler is mainly responsible for:
options: selecting the next ready process to run on the CPU
swapping processes out of and back into main memory
admitting new jobs from the job pool into memory
questions.exp: Medium-term scheduling reduces the degree of multiprogramming by swapping out processes and later swapping them in.

questions.q: Which statement about the complement of the halting problem is correct?
questions.exp: The halting problem is RE but undecidable; if its complement were also RE, it would be recursive.
Key a is overwritten, so the map has 2 entries and m[a] is 3: output 23.

questions.q: An asynchronous decade (mod-10) counter is cleared by a NAND gate as soon as the count reaches 1010. Which two outputs are connected to the NAND gate?
questions.exp: 1010 is the first state where both Q3 and Q1 are 1 (1001 has Q0 not Q1).

questions.q: Which of the following instructions can be executed only in kernel (privileged) mode?
options: Loading a value from the user's own memory
Instructions that perform I/O or modify the memory-management registers
Jumping to another instruction in the program
questions.exp: Privileged instructions such as direct I/O and MMU changes are restricted to kernel mode to protect the system.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): In C, an array name cannot be assigned a new value (for example a = b; is illegal for arrays).
Reason (R): The array name evaluates to the address of its first element, which is fixed and not a modifiable lvalue.
Choose the correct option.
options: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
questions.exp: The array name is a non-modifiable lvalue representing a fixed base address, which is why assignment to it is illegal.

questions.q: Which HTTP response header instructs the browser to store a cookie?
questions.exp: The server sends Set-Cookie; the browser returns it later in the Cookie request header.

questions.q: Four processes arrive at time 0 with CPU bursts 5, 9, 6 and 2 ms. Under non-preemptive SJF, what is the average waiting time?
questions.exp: Order 2, 5, 6, 9 gives waiting times 0, 2, 7, 13; sum 22, average 5.5.

questions.q: In a network, the link costs are A–B = 4, A–C = 2, C–B = 1, B–D = 5, C–D = 8 and D–E = 3. What is the shortest-path cost from A to E?

questions.exp: B overrides f; it returns "B" plus the parent's result "A" obtained via super().f(). Result: BA.

questions.q: Which bus carries signals such as READ, WRITE and interrupt acknowledge?
questions.exp: The control bus carries timing and control signals; the address bus (unidirectional) carries addresses, the data bus (bidirectional) carries data.

questions.q: In an 8086, AL = 7FH, BL = 01H and ADD AL,BL is executed. Which flag outcome is correct?
questions.exp: 7FH + 01H = 80H: no unsigned carry (CF = 0), but two positive numbers give a negative result so OF = 1 and SF = 1.

questions.q: In least-cost (LC) branch and bound, the next E-node is chosen as the live node with
questions.exp: LC search ranks live nodes by estimated cost and expands the most promising one.

questions.q: Sandwich (hybrid) integration testing combines:
questions.exp: Sandwich testing integrates the top layers top-down with stubs while the lower layers are integrated bottom-up with drivers, meeting in the middle.

questions.q:
Match the language with its main paradigm:
1. C   2. Java   3. Prolog   4. Haskell
P. Procedural   Q. Object-oriented   R. Logic   S. Functional
questions.exp: C is procedural, Java is object-oriented, Prolog is a logic language and Haskell is purely functional.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an uninformed (blind) search strategy?
questions.exp: Greedy best-first search uses a heuristic h(n), so it is informed.

questions.q: Which special function register of the 8051 holds the serial data for both transmission and reception?
questions.exp: SBUF is the serial buffer: writing sends data, reading gets received data (two physically separate registers at the same address).

questions.q: In a segmentation system, segment 2 has base 4300 and limit 400. What is the physical address for the logical address (segment 2, offset 53)?
questions.exp: Offset 53 < limit 400, so physical address = base + offset = 4300 + 53 = 4353.

questions.q: Match: 1 Corrective, 2 Adaptive, 3 Perfective, 4 Preventive with a) fixing defects, b) adjusting to a new operating system, c) adding requested features, d) restructuring to avoid future problems. Select the correct matching.
questions.exp: Corrective fixes faults, adaptive responds to environment change, perfective adds/enhances features, preventive restructures for future maintainability.
The loop swaps data of each adjacent pair (1,2) and (3,4); node 5 has no partner and is unchanged.

questions.q: For pure ALOHA with frame time T, the vulnerable time of a frame is:
questions.exp: A frame can collide with any frame sent in the interval T before or T after it, so vulnerable time is 2T.

questions.q: In the Rabin–Karp algorithm with text 31415926535, pattern 26 and modulus 11, the number of spurious hits is
questions.exp: 26 mod 11 = 4. Windows 15, 59 and 92 also give 4 but are not 26: three spurious hits.

questions.q: Which of the following sorting algorithms is NOT stable in its standard implementation?
questions.exp: Selection sort swaps the minimum with the current position, which can jump over equal keys and change their relative order.

questions.q: Which isolation level is the weakest, permitting dirty reads?
questions.exp: READ UNCOMMITTED lets a transaction read data not yet committed by others (dirty reads); the other levels prevent it.

questions.q: Keys 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 are inserted in this order into an empty B-tree of order 5 (maximum 4 keys per node). What does the root contain at the end?
questions.exp: The fifth key overflows [10,20,30,40,50]; the median 30 moves up as the new root with leaves [10,20] and [40,50].

questions.q: What does "Hello".substring(1, 3) return in Java?
questions.exp: substring(begin, end) returns characters from index 1 up to index 2, i.e. el.

questions.q: How many topological orderings does the DAG with edges A->C and B->C have?
questions.exp: C must be last; A and B can come in either order: A B C and B A C.

questions.q: For the grammar S → aAb, A → cA | ε, what is FOLLOW(A)?
questions.exp: A appears only just before b in S → aAb, and A → cA places A at the end of a right-hand side, adding FOLLOW(A) to itself; so FOLLOW(A) = {b}.

questions.q: In a vectored interrupt system, the interrupting device supplies
options: The opcode of the next instruction
An address or index that identifies its service routine
questions.exp: The vector lets the CPU jump directly to the correct interrupt service routine without polling devices.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
s = "level"
print(s == s[::-1], s.upper().isupper(), "a1".isalnum(), "12".isdigit(), "x y".isalpha())
questions.exp: level is a palindrome; the other tests are true except 'x y' which contains a space.

questions.q: Peephole optimization works by
options: analysing the whole program flow graph
optimizing only the source code before parsing
examining a small window of adjacent target instructions and replacing them with better ones
questions.exp: A peephole optimizer slides a small window over the generated code and applies local improvements.

questions.q: A fully associative cache with 3 lines uses LRU replacement and is initially empty. Block references arrive in the order 1, 2, 3, 1, 4, 2. The number of misses is
questions.exp: 1 M, 2 M, 3 M, 1 H, 4 M (evicts 2), 2 M (evicts 3): total 5 misses.

questions.q: An intranet that is extended to selected outside partners such as suppliers and customers is called a(n):
questions.exp: Extranet = intranet opened to trusted external parties, commonly used in B2B and EDI.

questions.q: In Python, in which order does the interpreter search for a name (the LEGB rule)?
questions.exp: Names are resolved first locally, then in enclosing functions, then globally, finally in built-ins.

questions.q: Statement I: 100% branch coverage guarantees 100% statement coverage (for code without unreachable statements). Statement II: 100% statement coverage guarantees 100% branch coverage. Which is correct?
options: Statement I is true and Statement II is false
Statement I is false and Statement II is true
questions.exp: Executing every branch executes every statement, but executing every statement may still miss e.g. the false outcome of an if without else.

questions.q: How many essential prime implicants does F(A, B, C) = Σm(0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7) have?
questions.exp: The six prime implicants (pairs 0-1, 1-5, 5-7, 7-6, 6-2, 2-0) form a cycle where every minterm is covered by exactly two of them, so none is essential.

questions.q: In reinforcement learning, an agent learns by
options: reducing the number of input features
interacting with an environment and receiving rewards or penalties
questions.exp: RL agents learn a policy that maximises cumulative reward through trial and error.

questions.q: A bank transfers Rs 500 from account A to B. The system crashes after A is debited but before B is credited. On restart A's debit is undone. Which ACID property ensures this?
questions.exp: Atomicity makes the transfer all-or-nothing, so the partial debit is rolled back.

questions.q: Which statement about horizontal microinstructions is correct?
options: They require extensive decoding of encoded fields
They have shorter control words than vertical microinstructions
They allow many micro-operations in parallel with little decoding
They can specify only one micro-operation at a time
questions.exp: Horizontal microcode has long words with one bit per control signal, giving high parallelism and minimal decoding.

questions.q: An organisation has 192.168.5.0/24 and needs at least 6 equal-sized subnets. What is the maximum number of usable hosts in each subnet?
questions.exp: Six subnets need 3 borrowed bits (8 subnets), leaving 5 host bits: 2⁵ − 2 = 30.

questions.q: Who invented the World Wide Web in 1989-91 while working at CERN?
questions.exp: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the WWW, HTML and HTTP at CERN.

questions.q: In C++, what are the default access levels of members of a struct and of a class respectively?
questions.exp: Members of a struct are public by default, members of a class are private by default. This (and the default inheritance mode) is the only difference between them.

questions.q: An 8-bit successive-approximation ADC completes one conversion in how many clock cycles?
questions.exp: The SAR tests one bit per clock starting from the MSB, so an n-bit conversion takes n clock pulses (8 for 8 bits).

questions.q: In Floyd–Warshall, the weights are 1→2: 4, 1→3: 11, 2→1: 6, 2→3: 2, 3→1: 3. The shortest distance from vertex 1 to vertex 3 is
questions.exp: Going 1→2→3 costs 4 + 2 = 6, less than the direct 11.

questions.q: In C++, which data members must be initialised using a constructor member initializer list?
questions.exp: const and reference members cannot be assigned later, so they must be initialised in the initializer list.

questions.q: In propositional logic, the implication P → Q is logically equivalent to
questions.exp: P → Q is false only when P is true and Q is false, which matches ¬P ∨ Q.

questions.q: In virtualization, the software layer that creates and manages virtual machines and shares the physical hardware among guest operating systems is called the:
questions.exp: A hypervisor (VMM) virtualises the CPU, memory and devices so several guest OSes run in isolated virtual machines. The bootstrap loader starts the OS, drivers control devices and the shell interprets commands.

questions.q: Which statement about FTP is correct?
options: It uses a persistent control connection and a separate data connection for each transfer
It uses only one UDP connection for both commands and data
It encrypts the user name and password by default
It does not need a login in its default form
questions.exp: FTP has a control connection (port 21) kept for the session and data connections (port 20 in active mode) per transfer. TFTP is the one over UDP without login.

questions.q: A weighted undirected graph has edges: A-B 2, A-C 3, B-C 1, B-D 4, C-D 5, C-E 7, D-E 8. What is the weight of the minimum spanning tree?
questions.exp: Kruskal picks B-C(1), A-B(2), B-D(4) and C-E(7): total 14 (A-C and C-D form cycles).

questions.q:
Assertion (A): A hash value can be used to check the integrity of a downloaded file.
Reason (R): Any change in the file produces a different hash value.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.exp: Comparing the computed hash with the published hash reveals tampering because even a small change alters the hash.

questions.q: In Java, with Parent p = new Child(); p.show(); where show() is overridden in Child, which version runs?
options: Child's version, chosen at run time
Parent's version, chosen at compile time
questions.exp: Dynamic method dispatch uses the actual object type at run time.

questions.q: How does an Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) differ from an Intrusion Detection System (IDS)?
options: An IPS only works on hosts and an IDS only on networks
An IDS encrypts traffic and an IPS decrypts it
An IPS cannot detect attacks, it only logs them
An IPS sits inline and can actively block malicious traffic, whereas an IDS mainly alerts
questions.exp: IDS monitors and raises alerts; IPS is placed in the traffic path and drops or blocks attacks.

questions.q: What is the maximum possible height (in edges) of an AVL tree with 7 nodes?
questions.exp: Minimum nodes of an AVL tree of height h are 1, 2, 4, 7 for h = 0..3 and 12 for h = 4, so 7 nodes allow height at most 3.

questions.q: In a resource-allocation graph where every resource type has a single instance, a cycle indicates that:
options: the system is in a safe state
a deadlock may or may not exist
questions.exp: With single-instance resources, a cycle is both necessary and sufficient for deadlock.

questions.q: Lomuto partition with the last element as pivot is applied to [7, 2, 9, 4, 6, 5]. The array after partition is
questions.exp: Elements ≤ 5 (2 then 4) are swapped to the front, then the pivot is swapped into index 2.

questions.q: The very first block of a blockchain is known as the:
questions.exp: The first block, which has no previous block, is called the genesis block.

questions.q:
Statement I: An abstract class in Java may have no abstract methods.
Statement II: An object of an abstract class can be created with new if it has a public constructor.
Which is correct?
options: Statement I is true and Statement II is false
Statement I is false and Statement II is true
questions.exp: An abstract class can be declared without abstract methods, but it can never be instantiated directly.

questions.q: In a BST with root 50 whose right subtree has root 70 with left child 60 and right child 80, what is the inorder successor of 50?
questions.exp: The inorder successor is the leftmost node of the right subtree, which is 60.

questions.q: In K-map minimisation, a 'don't care' condition is
options: treated as 1 or 0, whichever gives a simpler expression
questions.exp: Don't cares may be included in groups when that enlarges the group, and otherwise ignored.

questions.q: A free game installer secretly opens a backdoor on the computer but does not copy itself to other files or machines. It is a
questions.exp: A trojan masquerades as useful software and does not self-replicate.

questions.q: In Diffie-Hellman key exchange with p = 11 and g = 2, Alice's secret is 3 and Bob's secret is 4. The shared secret key is
questions.exp: A = 2³ mod 11 = 8; B = 2⁴ mod 11 = 5; key = 5³ mod 11 = 125 mod 11 = 4 (also 8⁴ mod 11 = 4).

questions.q: In the standard phases of hacking, using a tool such as Nmap to find open ports and running services belongs to the phase of
questions.exp: Phases: reconnaissance, scanning, gaining access, maintaining access, covering tracks; port scanning is the scanning phase.

questions.q: The forward reference problem in assembly language is usually solved by
questions.exp: The first pass collects all label addresses so the second pass can resolve forward references.
The implicit super() call runs the parent constructor first.

questions.q: In MQTT, which Quality of Service (QoS) level guarantees that a message is delivered exactly once?
questions.exp: QoS 0 is at most once, QoS 1 at least once and QoS 2 exactly once; there is no QoS 3.

questions.q:
Match the expression with its value:
(i) math.ceil(4.2)  (ii) math.floor(-4.2)  (iii) round(4.5)  (iv) abs(-4.2)
(a) 4.2  (b) 5  (c) -5  (d) 4
questions.exp: ceil(4.2)=5, floor(-4.2)=-5, round(4.5)=4 (banker's rounding), abs(-4.2)=4.2.

questions.q: If both a language L and its complement are recursively enumerable, then L is
questions.exp: Run the two recognizers in parallel; exactly one halts and accepts, giving a decider.

questions.q: Which preprocessor directive is used to remove the definition of a previously defined macro?
questions.exp: #undef NAME cancels a macro definition made with #define.

questions.q: How many address lines are required to interface a 4K x 8 memory chip?
questions.exp: 4K = 4096 = 2^12 locations, so 12 address lines are needed.

questions.q: Which of the following is a CISC architecture?
questions.exp: x86 has variable-length, complex instructions; ARM, MIPS and SPARC are RISC designs.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
def p(n):
    if n == 0:
        return
    p(n - 1)
    print(n, end=' ')
p(3)
questions.exp: The print happens after the recursive call returns, so the values appear in order 1, 2, 3.

questions.q: A Turing machine M recognises L and loops forever on some input w that is not in L. This is allowed because L is only required to be:
questions.exp: A recogniser must halt and accept strings in L, but may loop on others; a decider must always halt.

questions.q: In a Node.js project, which file holds the project's metadata and the list of npm dependencies?
questions.exp: npm records name, version, scripts and dependencies in package.json; installed modules go into node_modules.

questions.q: A(x) = {1,2,3}, B(y) = {2,3,4}. How many rows does SELECT x FROM A UNION SELECT y FROM B return?
questions.exp: UNION removes duplicates, leaving the distinct values 1, 2, 3, 4: 4 rows (UNION ALL would give 6).

questions.q: A table has a column Phone storing values like '98765, 91234' in a single cell. This design violates
questions.exp: 1NF requires atomic (indivisible) attribute values; storing several phone numbers in one cell breaks it.

questions.q: A relation R(A, B, C) has two candidate keys, A and B (each a single attribute). How many superkeys does R have?
questions.exp: Of the 8 subsets of {A,B,C}, only those containing neither A nor B (the empty set and {C}) are not superkeys. 8 − 2 = 6.

questions.q: Two vertically adjacent block siblings have margin-bottom: 30px on the first and margin-top: 20px on the second. What is the gap between them due to margin collapsing?
questions.exp: Adjoining vertical margins collapse to the larger of the two, i.e. 30px.

questions.q: Which statement correctly compares SRAM and DRAM?
options: SRAM needs refresh and is cheaper per bit than DRAM
DRAM is faster than SRAM and is used for cache
Both need refreshing but SRAM has lower density
SRAM uses a flip-flop cell and needs no refresh; DRAM uses a transistor-capacitor cell and needs refresh
questions.exp: SRAM (6 transistors) is fast and used for cache; DRAM (1 transistor + 1 capacitor) is denser and cheaper, used as main memory, but needs refresh.

questions.q: In a credit card transaction, the 'acquiring bank' is the bank that:
options: Issues the credit card to the customer
Prints the card and sends it to the customer
Regulates all banks in the country
Holds the merchant's account and processes card payments on its behalf
questions.exp: The acquirer serves the merchant; the issuer serves the cardholder.

questions.q: An even parity bit is added as the MSB to the 7-bit data 1101011. The resulting 8-bit word is
questions.exp: Data has five 1s (odd), so parity bit 1 makes the total six, which is even.

questions.q: A buffer in I/O management is:
options: a memory area that temporarily holds data while it is transferred between two entities
a hardware port for the keyboard
questions.exp: Buffers cope with speed mismatch between producer and consumer of data.

questions.q:
What is the output?
console.log(0.1 + 0.2 === 0.3);
questions.exp: Floating-point representation makes 0.1 + 0.2 equal 0.30000000000000004, so the comparison is false.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a valid topological ordering of the DAG with edges 5->2, 5->0, 4->0, 4->1, 2->3, 3->1?
questions.exp: In 5 2 3 1 4 0 vertex 1 appears before 4 although 4->1 is an edge, so the order is invalid.

questions.q: Which OSI layer is responsible for dialog control and synchronization using checkpoints?
questions.exp: The session layer manages dialogs and inserts synchronization points (checkpoints) in a data stream.

questions.q: In UML, which diagram best shows the time-ordered sequence of messages exchanged between objects?
questions.exp: A sequence diagram arranges object interactions along a vertical time axis.
C passes arguments by value, so swap works on copies and x, y remain unchanged.

questions.q: The time complexity of Kruskal's algorithm on a graph with V vertices and E edges is
questions.exp: Sorting the edges dominates; union-find operations are nearly constant.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a component of the ER model?
questions.exp: A tuple is a relational-model term; entities, weak entities, relationships and attributes belong to the ER model.

questions.q: R(Student, Course, Instructor) has FDs (Student, Course) → Instructor and Instructor → Course. Which statement is correct?
options: R is in 3NF but not in BCNF; its BCNF decomposition is lossless but does not preserve (Student, Course) → Instructor
Every BCNF decomposition of R preserves all the dependencies
questions.exp: Candidate keys are (Student, Course) and (Student, Instructor), so Course is prime and 3NF holds; but Instructor → Course has a non-key determinant, violating BCNF. Splitting into (Instructor, Course) and (Student, Instructor) is lossless but loses the first FD.

questions.q: Which multimedia hardware component converts the analog signal from a microphone into digital samples?
questions.exp: A sound card contains an analog-to-digital converter for audio input and a DAC for output.

questions.q: Given Student(sid, name) and Enrolled(sid, cid), which expression gives the sids of students not enrolled in any course?
questions.exp: Set difference of all student ids minus ids that appear in Enrolled leaves the students with no enrollment.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
def f(a, b, *c, d=1, **e):
    print(a, b, c, d, e)
f(1, 2, 3, 4, d=5, x=6)
questions.exp: *c collects extra positionals as a tuple, d is keyword-only, and **e collects unknown keywords.

questions.q: Which serial bus uses only two lines called SDA and SCL?
questions.exp: The Inter-Integrated Circuit bus uses a serial data line (SDA) and a serial clock line (SCL).

questions.q: On a single-accumulator (one-address) machine, the minimum number of instructions needed to compute X = (A + B) * C is
questions.exp: LOAD A, ADD B, MUL C, STORE X: four instructions.

questions.q: Skinner's operant conditioning emphasises that behaviour is controlled by
questions.exp: Behaviour followed by reinforcement is strengthened; operants act on the environment.

questions.q: The satellite launched in 2004 exclusively for educational services in India is:
questions.exp: EDUSAT, launched on 20 September 2004, was dedicated to educational broadcasting.

questions.q: After being told that a zebra is a different animal, the child creates a new category for zebras. This is
questions.exp: Accommodation is changing or creating schemas to fit new information.

questions.q: According to Dewey, the first step in the problem-solving method is:
questions.exp: Dewey's steps begin with recognising a felt difficulty, then defining it, hypothesising, testing and concluding.

questions.q: Twin studies, comparing identical twins raised apart, are mainly used to estimate
options: the relative influence of heredity and environment
the effect of motivation on memory
questions.exp: Identical twins share genes; differences when reared apart point to environmental influences.

questions.q: A cumulative record card of a student is useful mainly for
options: understanding the student's overall development and guiding him
questions.exp: It stores continuous data on academic, personal and social growth.

questions.q: A student who performs below the level expected from his ability is called
questions.exp: Underachievement is a gap between potential and performance.

questions.q: Which body is responsible for developing the National Curriculum Framework and model textbooks?
questions.exp: NCERT prepares the NCF and model textbooks for schools.

questions.q: Which of the following is a projective test of personality?
questions.exp: TAT, developed by Murray and Morgan, asks subjects to tell stories about pictures.

questions.q: OER stands for:
questions.exp: OER are freely available teaching and learning materials.

questions.q: Which of the following is a characteristic of ADHD?
questions.exp: ADHD involves persistent inattention and hyperactivity-impulsivity.

questions.q: A good lesson plan should be:
options: flexible enough to be adjusted to the class situation
copied from another teacher without change
questions.exp: Flexibility lets the teacher respond to students' needs.

questions.q: The dependent variable in an experiment on the effect of a new teaching method on marks is:
questions.exp: Marks depend on the method.

questions.q: Convergent thinking involves
options: arriving at the single best answer to a problem
questions.exp: Convergent thinking narrows down to one correct solution.

questions.q: Admiring and imitating a film star or leader without questioning is called
questions.exp: Hero worship is a typical adolescent tendency.

questions.q: Asking follow-up questions to push a student to give a complete or deeper answer is the skill of:
questions.exp: Probing prompts students to clarify, extend or justify their responses.

questions.q: Which of the following is a principle of curriculum construction?
questions.exp: A good curriculum considers the needs and interests of the learner.

questions.q: A diagnostic test differs from an achievement test because it:
options: has many small items on specific skills to locate weak points
is conducted only at the end of the year
questions.exp: It analyses specific skills rather than giving an overall measure.

questions.q: A rubric is:
options: a scoring guide listing criteria and performance levels
questions.exp: Rubrics make scoring of projects and essays transparent and consistent.

questions.q: Which of the following would INCREASE the reliability of a test?
options: Increasing the number of good-quality items
questions.exp: A longer test with well-written items gives more stable scores.

questions.q: Which is NOT one of the four processes of observational learning in Bandura's theory?
questions.exp: The processes are attention, retention, reproduction and motivation.

questions.q: Stage 6 of Kohlberg's theory is oriented towards
questions.exp: At the top stage individuals follow self-chosen universal principles such as justice and human rights.

questions.q: In the teaching of CS, a practical examination along with a viva voce is useful as it:
options: tests skills and understanding that written tests cannot
questions.exp: Hands-on tasks and oral questioning show real competence.

questions.q: A democratic teacher in the classroom:
options: encourages participation and respects students' opinions
questions.exp: A democratic style promotes participation and responsibility.

questions.q: Initiative versus guilt is the crisis of
questions.exp: Preschoolers who plan and start activities develop initiative; harsh criticism produces guilt.

questions.q: In Weiner's attribution theory, which cause is both internal and stable?
questions.exp: Ability is inside the person and relatively fixed; effort is internal but unstable.

questions.q: A teacher first models how to solve a problem, then gives hints, and finally lets the student solve it alone. This is an example of
questions.exp: Progressive withdrawal of help matches scaffolding within the ZPD.

questions.q: The 'Zone of Proximal Development' (ZPD) given by Vygotsky refers to the gap between:
options: what a learner can do alone and what the learner can do with guidance
a learner's age and mental age
the teacher's and learner's knowledge of the subject
questions.exp: ZPD is the range of tasks a learner can complete only with help from a more knowledgeable person.

questions.q: The mean of the scores 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 is:
Howard Gardner is known for the theory of
questions.exp: Gardner proposed several relatively independent intelligences such as linguistic, musical and bodily-kinaesthetic.

questions.q: Who was the Governor-General of India at the time of the Revolt of 1857?
questions.exp: Lord Canning was Governor-General (1856-62) and became the first Viceroy in 1858.

questions.q: Which pass connects Srinagar with Leh?
questions.exp: Zoji La, in the Pir Panjal/Himalaya region, links Srinagar and Leh on NH-1.

questions.q: The Kesaria stupa, one of the largest Buddhist stupas in the world, is located in which district of Bihar?
questions.exp: Kesaria Stupa is in East Champaran (Purvi Champaran) district.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution provides for the Election Commission of India?
questions.exp: Article 324 vests superintendence, direction and control of elections in the Election Commission.

questions.q: Which of the following is a direct tax?
questions.exp: A direct tax is borne by the person on whom it is levied, e.g. income tax; GST and duties are indirect.

questions.q: Which of the following is the correct set of the three levels of biodiversity?
questions.exp: Biodiversity is studied at genetic, species and ecosystem levels.

questions.q: Narmada Bachao Andolan was led by
questions.exp: Medha Patkar led the movement against large dams on the Narmada, especially the Sardar Sarovar project.

questions.q: The Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora is commonly known as
questions.exp: CITES (1973, Washington) regulates international trade in endangered species.

questions.q: Which convention regulates the transboundary movement of hazardous wastes?
questions.exp: The Basel Convention (1989) controls the movement and disposal of hazardous wastes across borders.

questions.q: Valmiki Tiger Reserve, the only tiger reserve of Bihar, is located in which district?
questions.exp: Valmiki Tiger Reserve lies in West Champaran, bordering Nepal's Chitwan National Park.

questions.q: A family's monthly budget is Rs 36,000. A pie chart shows 40% on food and 25% on rent. How much is spent on food and rent together?
What single discount is equivalent to two successive discounts of 10% and 20%?
questions.exp: Net price factor = 0.9 x 0.8 = 0.72, so the single discount is 28%.

questions.q: A 13 m ladder leans against a wall with its foot 5 m from the wall. How high up the wall does it reach?
How many prime numbers lie between 20 and 40?
questions.exp: The primes are 23, 29, 31 and 37, so there are 4.

questions.q: A's salary is 25% more than B's. By what percent is B's salary less than A's?
questions.exp: Let B = 100, A = 125; B is 25 less than A, and 25/125 x 100 = 20%.

questions.q: If the letters of the word DIRECTION are arranged in alphabetical order, which letter will be fourth from the right end?
questions.exp: Sorted: C D E I I N O R T. From the right: T, R, O, N. The fourth is N.

questions.q: In a certain code, CAB is written as 312 and BED as 254. How is DEAF written in that code?
questions.exp: Each letter is replaced by its alphabet position and joined: D=4, E=5, A=1, F=6, giving 4516.

questions.q: Given: A + B means A is the mother of B; A − B means A is the brother of B; A × B means A is the sister of B. Which expression shows that M is the maternal uncle of N?
questions.exp: M − K + N means M is the brother of K and K is the mother of N, so M is N's mother's brother (maternal uncle). The other options give an aunt or a mother.

questions.q: One morning Anita and Bina stand back to back with the sun in front of Anita. Towards which direction is Bina's right hand pointing?
questions.exp: In the morning the sun is in the east, so Anita faces east and Bina faces west. Facing west, the right hand points north.

questions.q: In a test, 8 students scored higher than Neha and 12 students scored lower than her (no ties). How many students took the test?
questions.exp: Total = 8 + 1 (Neha) + 12 = 21.
